description_en: Queries the details of data flow tasks
description_zh: 查询数据流动任务详细信息
name: DescribeDataFlowTasks

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID.

General-purpose CPFS: must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-099394bd928c****.

CPFS for Lingjun: must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS通用版：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-099394bd928c****。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
parameters.name: file_system_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the filter key.

Valid values:

DataFlowIds: filters by data flow ID.
TaskIds: filters by data flow task ID.
Originator: filters by the initiator of the data flow task.
TaskActions: filters by the type of the data flow task.
DataTypes: filters by the data type of the data flow task.
Status: filters by data flow status.
CreateTimeBegin: filters data flow tasks created after the specified time.
CreateTimeEnd: filters data flow tasks created before the specified time.
StartTimeBegin: filters data flow tasks started after the specified time.
StartTimeEnd: filters data flow tasks started before the specified time.
EndTimeBegin: filters data flow tasks ended after the specified time.
EndTimeEnd: filters data flow tasks ended before the specified time
fields.help_zh:
筛选键的名称。

取值：

DataFlowIds: 根据数据流动ID筛选。
TaskIds：根据数据流动任务的ID筛选。
Originator：根据数据流动任务的发起者筛选。
TaskActions：根据数据流动任务的类型筛选。
DataTypes：根据数据流动任务的数据类型筛选。
Status：根据数据流动状态筛选。
CreateTimeBegin：筛选指定时间后创建的数据流动任务。
CreateTimeEnd：筛选指定时间前创建的数据流动任务。
StartTimeBegin：筛选指定时间后启动的数据流动任务。
StartTimeEnd：筛选指定时间前启动的数据流动任务。
EndTimeBegin：筛选指定时间后结束的数据流动任务。
EndTimeEnd：筛选指定时间前结束的数据流动任务
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter key. Wildcards are not supported.

If Key is set to DataFlowIds, Value is set to a data flow ID or part of a data flow ID. You can specify one or more data flow IDs. A maximum of 10 data flow IDs can be specified. Example: `df-194433a5be31****` or `df-194433a512a2****,df-234533a5be31****`.
If Key is set to TaskId, Value is set to a data flow task ID or part of a data flow task ID. You can specify one or more data flow task IDs. A maximum of 10 data flow task IDs can be specified. Example: `task-38aa8e890f45****` or `task-38aa8e890f45****,task-29ae8e890f45****`.
If Key is set to TaskActions, Value is set to the type of the data flow task, including Import, Export, Evict, Inventory, StreamImport, and StreamExport. Combined queries are supported. CPFS for Lingjun supports only Import, Export, StreamImport, and StreamExport. StreamImport and StreamExport are supported only by CPFS for Lingjun 2.6.0 and later.
If Key is set to DataTypes, Value is set to the data type of the data flow task, including MetaAndData, Metadata, and Data. Combined queries are supported.
If Key is set to Originator, Value is set to the initiator of the data flow task, including User and System.
If Key is set to Status, Value is set to the status of the data flow task, including Pending, Executing, Failed, Completed, Canceling, and Canceled. Combined queries are supported.
If Key is set to CreateTimeBegin, Value is set to the earliest creation time of data flow tasks. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`.
If Key is set to CreateTimeEnd, Value is set to the latest creation time of data flow tasks. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`.
If Key is set to StartTimeBegin, Value is set to the earliest start time of data flow tasks. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`.
If Key is set to StartTimeEnd, Value is set to the latest start time of data flow tasks. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`.
If Key is set to EndTimeBegin, Value is set to the earliest end time of data flow tasks. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`.
If Key is set to EndTimeEnd, Value is set to the latest end time of data flow tasks. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`
fields.help_zh:
筛选键的值。该参数不支持通配符。

Key取值为DataFlowIds时，Value取值为数据流动ID或数据流动ID的一部分。可以是一个或一组DataFlowId，数据流动ID最多可设置10个。例如，`df-194433a5be31****`或`df-194433a512a2****,df-234533a5be31****`。
当Key取值为TaskId时，Value取值为数据流动任务ID或数据流动任务ID的部分。可以是一个或一组数据流动任务ID，数据流动任务ID最多可设置10个。例如，`task-38aa8e890f45****`或`task-38aa8e890f45****,task-29ae8e890f45****`。
当Key取值为TaskActions时，Value取值为数据流动的任务类型，包括Import，Export、Evict、Inventory、StreamImport和StreamExport。支持组合查询。目前 CPFS 智算版只支持 Import、Export、StreamImport 和 StreamExport。StreamImport 和 StreamExport 仅 CPFS 智算版 2.6.0 版本及以上版本支持。
当Key取值为DataTypes时，Value取值为数据流动任务的数据类型，包括MetaAndData、Metadata和Data。支持组合查询。
当Key取值为Originator时，Value取值为数据流动任务的发起者，包括User，System。
当Key取值为Status时，Value取值为数据流动任务的状态，包括Pending、Executing、Failed、Completed、Canceling和Canceled。支持组合查询。
当Key取值为CreateTimeBegin时，Value取值为数据流动任务创建时间最小值。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`。
当Key取值为CreateTimeEnd时，Value取值为数据流动任务创建时间最大值。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`。
当Key取值为StartTimeBegin时，Value取值为数据流动任务启动时间最小值。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`。
当Key取值为StartTimeEnd时，Value取值为数据流动任务启动时间最大值。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`。
当Key取值为EndTimeBegin时，Value取值为数据流动任务结束时间最小值。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`。
当Key取值为EndTimeEnd时，Value取值为数据流动任务结束时间最大值。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return results are truncated, you can use NextToken to initiate a new request to retrieve the content after the truncation point
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。

默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query report information.

True (default): queries reports.
False: does not query reports.

Setting this parameter to False can speed up queries.
Only CPFS for Lingjun is supported
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询报表信息。

True（默认值）：查询报表。
False：不查询报表。

设置为False可以加快查询速度。
仅支持CPFS智算版
parameters.name: with_reports

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return results are truncated, you can use NextToken to initiate a new request to retrieve the content after the truncation point
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

Task.description_en: The collection of data flow task information
Task.description_zh: 数据流动任务的信息集合

ConflictPolicy.description_en:
The file name conflict policy.

SKIP_THE_FILE: skips files with the same name.
KEEP_LATEST: compares the update time and keeps the latest version.
OVERWRITE_EXISTING: forcibly overwrites files with the same name
ConflictPolicy.description_zh:
同名文件冲突策略。

SKIP_THE_FILE：跳过同名文件。
KEEP_LATEST：比较更新时间，保留最新版本。
OVERWRITE_EXISTING：强制覆盖同名文件

enumValueTitles.KEEP_LATEST: 比较更新时间，保留最新版本

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间。执行 ISO8601 标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

DataType.description_en:
The data type of the data flow task. Valid values:

Metadata: the metadata of files, including the timestamp, ownership, permission, and other attribute information. If Metadata is selected, only the metadata of files is imported. Users can see the file, but when the file data is accessed, the data is loaded from the source storage on demand.
Data: the data blocks of files.
MetaAndData: the metadata and data blocks of files.
CPFS for Lingjun supports only the MetaAndData type
DataType.description_zh:
数据流动任务操作的数据类型。包括：

Metadata：文件的元数据，包括文件的timestamp, ownership, permission等属性信息。选择Metadata，只会导入文件的元数据，用户只能看到该文件，但访问该文件数据时，数据从源端存储按需加载。
Data：文件的数据块。
MetaAndData：文件的元数据和数据块。
CPFS智算版仅支持 MetaAndData 类型

Directory.description_en: The directory in which the data flow task is executed
Directory.description_zh: 数据流动任务执行的目录
Directory.title_zh: 数据流动任务执行的目录

DstDirectory.description_en: The target directory to which the data flow task is mapped
DstDirectory.description_zh: 数据流动任务映射目标目录

EndTime.description_en: The time when the task ended. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间。执行 ISO8601 标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

EntryList.description_en:
The list of files for the data flow task.

Limits:

UTF-8 encoding is used.
The total length of the file list must be less than 64 KB.
The file list is in JSON format.
The length of each file path is 1 to 1023 characters and must start with a forward slash (/).
If TaskAction is Import, each element in the list represents an OSS object name.
If TaskAction is Export, each element in the list represents a CPFS file path.
Directory, EntryList, and TransferFileListPath are mutually exclusive parameters. You can specify only one of them
EntryList.description_zh:
数据流动任务执行的文件列表。

限制：

使用UTF-8编码。
文件列表总长度小于64KB。
文件列表采用JSON格式。
单个文件路径长度为 1~1023 个字符，且必须以正斜线（/）开头。
当TaskAction为Import时，列表中每个元素代表一个OSS Object名称。
当TaskAction为Export时，列表中每个元素代表一个CPFS文件路径。
Directory、EntryList、TransferFileListPath 为互斜参数，只能三者选一

ErrorMsg.description_en:
The error message of the task.
If this field is not returned or is empty, no error occurred
ErrorMsg.description_zh:
任务异常原因。
当该字段未返回或者返回为空时，表示没有错误信息

FileSystemPath.description_en:
The path of the fileset in the CPFS file system.

Limits:

The length is 2 to 1024 characters.
UTF-8 encoding is used.
The path must start and end with a forward slash (/).
The directory must be a fileset directory on CPFS.
Only CPFS supports this parameter
FileSystemPath.description_zh:
Fileset在CPFS文件系统中的路径。

限制：

长度为2~1024个英文或中文字符。
使用UTF-8编码。
必须以/开头和结尾。
该目录必须是CPFS上的Fileset目录。
仅CPFS支持该参数

Includes.description_en:
Filters directories under the directory parameter and transfers the content of the included folders.

Only CPFS for Lingjun supports this feature
Includes.description_zh:
过滤directory下目录，传输过滤目录内包含的文件夹内容。

仅CPFS智算版支持该功能

Originator.description_en:
The initiator of the data flow task. Valid values:

User: the user initiated the task.
System: the task is an automatic update task that is automatically initiated by CPFS based on the automatic update interval.
Only CPFS supports this parameter
Originator.description_zh:
数据流动任务的发起者。
包括：

User：用户是该任务的发起者。
System：该任务是自动更新任务，是CPFS根据自动更新间隔时间自动发起的任务。
仅CPFS支持该参数

Progress.description_en: The progress of the data flow task. The number of operations that have been performed by the current data flow task
Progress.description_zh: 数据流动任务的进度。当前数据流动任务已经执行的操作数量

ProgressStats.description_en: The progress information of the data flow task
ProgressStats.description_zh: 数据流动任务进度信息

ActualBytes.description_en: The actual amount of data transferred. Unit: bytes
ActualBytes.description_zh: 实际流动数据量。单位：字节

ActualFiles.description_en: The actual number of files transferred

AverageSpeed.description_en: The average transfer speed. Unit: bytes per second

BytesDone.description_en: The amount of data for which data flow is completed (including skipped data). Unit: bytes
BytesDone.description_zh: 已完成数据流动数据量（包括跳过数据）。单位：字节

BytesTotal.description_en: The amount of data scanned at the source. Unit: bytes
BytesTotal.description_zh: 源端扫描到数据量。单位：字节

FilesDone.description_en: The number of files for which data flow is completed (including skipped files)
FilesDone.description_zh: 已完成数据流动文件数（包括跳过）

FilesTotal.description_en: The number of files scanned at the source

RemainTime.description_en: The estimated remaining time. Unit: seconds
RemainTime.description_zh: 预计剩余完成时间。单位：秒

ReportPath.description_en:
The path where the data flow task report is saved in the CPFS file system.

For CPFS, the task report is generated in the `.dataflow_report` directory of the CPFS file system.
For CPFS for Lingjun, an OSS download link is returned. You can use the link to download the task report
ReportPath.description_zh:
数据流动任务报告在CPFS文件系统中保存的路径。

CPFS的任务报告会生成在该CPFS的`.dataflow_report`目录中。
CPFS智算版会返回一个oss下载链接，可以通过链接下载任务报告

Report.description_en:
The list of reports.
Streaming tasks do not support reports.
If WithReport is set to True, this parameter returns report data for CPFS for Lingjun.
Only CPFS for Lingjun supports the WithReport parameter
Report.description_zh:
报告列表。
流式任务不支持报告。
当WithReport=True时，该参数会返回CPFS智算版报告数据。
仅CPFS智算版支持WithReport参数

Name.description_en:
The report name.

CPFS:

  TotalFilesReport: the task report.
CPFS for Lingjun:
FailedFilesReport: the report of failed files.
SkippedFilesReport: the report of skipped files.
SuccessFilesReport: the report of successful files
Name.description_zh:
报告名称。

CPFS：

  TotalFilesReport：任务报告。
CPFS智算版：
FailedFilesReport：失败的文件报告。
SkippedFilesReport：跳过的文件报告。
SuccessFilesReport：成功文件报告

SourceStorage.description_en:
The access address of the source storage. Format: `<storage type>://[<account id>:]<path>`.

Where:

storage type: only oss is supported.
account id: the UID of the account to which the source storage belongs.
path: the name of the OSS bucket. Limits:

    - Only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-) are supported. The name must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit.

    - The maximum length is 128 characters.

    - UTF-8 encoding is used.

The OSS bucket must be an existing bucket in the region.
The account id parameter is supported only by CPFS for Lingjun 2.6.0 and later
SourceStorage.description_zh:
源端存储的访问地址。格式：`<storage type>://[<account id>:]<path>`。

其中：

storage type：目前只支持oss。
account id：源端存储所属账号的UID。
path：OSS的Bucket名称。限制如下。

    - 仅支持小写字母、数字和短划线（-）且必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾。

    - 最长为128个字符。

    - 使用UTF-8编码。

OSS Bucket必须为在该地域已存在的Bucket。
仅CPFS智算版2.6.0及以上版本支持 account id 参数

StartTime.description_en: The time when the task started. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始执行时间。执行 ISO8601 标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Status.description_en:
The status of the data flow task. Valid values:

Pending: the data flow task has been created and is queued but has not started.
Executing: the data flow task is being executed.
Failed: the data flow task failed. You can view the data flow task report to check the failure reason.
Completed: the data flow task is completed. You can view the data flow task report to verify that all files have been transferred correctly.
Canceled: the data flow task was canceled and did not complete.
Canceling: the data flow task is being canceled
Status.description_zh:
数据流动任务的状态。包括：

Pending: 数据流动任务已创建，在排队中未开始执行。
Executing：数据流动任务在执行中。
Failed：数据流动任务执行失败，可以通过查看数据流动任务报告，查看失败原因。
Completed：数据流动任务执行结束，可以通过查看数据流动任务报告，查看所有文件已正确传输。
Canceled：数据流动任务被取消并且没有完成。
Canceling：数据流动任务正在被取消

TaskAction.description_en:
The type of the data flow node. Valid values:

Import: performs data import of specified data from the source storage to CPFS.
Export: exports specified data from CPFS to the source storage.
StreamImport: performs data import of specified data from the source storage to CPFS as a data stream node.
StreamExport: exports specified data from CPFS to the source storage as a data stream node.
Evict: releases data blocks of files on CPFS. After the release, only metadata is retained on CPFS. You can still query the file, but the data blocks are purged and do not occupy storage capacity on CPFS. When the file data is accessed, it is loaded from the source storage on demand.
Inventory: obtains the checklist of files managed by data flow on CPFS, which provides the cache status of files in the data flow.
StreamImport and StreamExport are supported only by CPFS for Lingjun 2.6.0 and later
TaskAction.description_zh:
数据流动任务类型。包括：

Import：从源端存储将指定的数据导入至CPFS。
Export：将CPFS上指定的数据导出至源端存储。
StreamImport：从源端存储将指定的数据流式任务导入至CPFS。
StreamExport：将CPFS上指定的数据流式任务导出至源端存储。
Evict：释放CPFS上文件的数据块，释放后文件在CPFS上只保留元数据，您仍能查询该文件，但文件数据块已清除，不占用CPFS上的存储容量。当访问该文件数据时，将再从源端存储按需加载。
Inventory：获取CPFS上数据流动管理的文件清单，可提供文件在数据流动中的缓存状态。
StreamImport和StreamExport仅CPFS智算版2.6.0版本及以上版本支持

TransferFileListPath.description_en:
Specifies an OSS directory and synchronizes data based on the content of CSV files in the OSS directory.
Only CPFS for Lingjun supports this feature
TransferFileListPath.description_zh:
指定oss目录，根据oss目录中的csv文件的内容同步数据。
仅CPFS智算版支持该功能
